ezra.3.p1.b1.text: By the seventh month, the Israelites had settled in their towns, and the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.

ezra.3.p1.b2.text: Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his fellow priests, along with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates, began to build the altar of the God of Israel …

ezra.3.p1.b3.text: They set up the altar on its foundation … even though they feared the people of the land.

ezra.3.p1.b4.text: and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings …

ezra.3.p2.b1.text: They also celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles in accordance with what is written, …

ezra.3.p2.b2.text: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings and those for New Moons and for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.

ezra.3.p2.b3.text: On the first day of the seventh month, the Israelites began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD, although the foundation of the temple of the LORD had not been laid.

ezra.3.p2.b4.text: … to bring cedar logs from Lebanon to Joppa by sea, as authorized by Cyrus king of Persia.

ezra.3.p2.b5.text: They gave money to the masons and carpenters, and food and drink and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre …

ezra.3.p3.b1.text: In the second month of the second year …

ezra.3.p3.b2.text: … Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their associates … began the work.

ezra.3.p3.b3.text: They appointed Levites twenty years of age or older to supervise the construction of the house of the LORD.

ezra.3.p3.b4.text: … all Levites—joined together to supervise those working on the house of God.

ezra.3.p4.b1.text: When the builders had laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their apparel with trumpets, …

ezra.3.p4.b2.text: and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel had prescribed.

ezra.3.p4.b4.text: for His loving devotion to Israel endures forever.

ezra.3.p4.b5.text: Then all the people gave a great shout of praise to the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.

ezra.3.p5.b1.text: But many of the older priests, Levites, and family heads who had seen the first temple …

ezra.3.p5.b2.text: … wept loudly when they saw the foundation of this temple.

ezra.3.p5.b4.text: The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping,

ezra.3.p5.b5.text: because the people were making so much noise. And the sound was heard from afar.
